title: Fixed Open Hood and Caster Stand Salon Dryer
description: One original complete static salon hood-dryer appearance. A broad tilted double-wall domed shell has a genuinely open lower mouth and a continuous deep empty head chamber, without a lamp diffuser or a painted black opening. The dome is connected to a separate closed rear motor-case appearance over a fixed two-stage mast with a blank unlit control panel and one knob. Five whole radial support branches end at separate ground-contacting wheels and fixed forks. Every part is newly authored: this is neither the small conical observation lamp renamed nor the styling-chair pedestal reused. Three opaque PBR roles. One complete prop, zero scenes, chair or person. Fixed visual equipment only; no drying or heating performance, air-flow simulation, electrical design, hair-treatment recommendation, adjustment, bearing, load, ergonomics or safety claim.
